def_en: 3) toward (of direction, not necessarily physical motion)
4) against (motion or direction of a hostile character)
6) concerning, in regard to, in reference to, on account of
9) in between, in within, to within, unto (idea of motion to)
kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
expl: near, with or among; often in general, to
etim: (but only used in the shortened constructive form ); a primitive particle; properly, denoting motion towards, but occasionally used of a quiescent position, i.e.
